who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), lane M (lazy program's seam methods) under rebuild-1115
where: crates/blaze-ladder/src/front2/program.rs (shared with E and a reach.rs lane)
what: My four small edits to program.rs (a `mod seam_rules;` line and three bodies moved to the shared rules) vanished at 03:27: another lane wrote the whole file from its own older copy while editing reach.rs and walk_report.rs. cost: about twenty minutes and four runner rounds
cause: two lanes write one file in one directory, one of them by whole-file writes
whys: program.rs is the home of Front2Program and of several lanes' hooks; a lane that rewrites it whole loses the edits made since it read it; the runner cuts files as they are on disk
class: a lane's whole-file write over a file another lane edits drops that lane's edits silently
prevention: wanted: a shared file is edited by exact replacement only (Edit), never rewritten whole; a lane keeps a shared rule in its own directory and names the one-line hook another lane's file needs (done here: the rules live in lazy/seam_rules.rs)
workaround: the shared rules moved to front2/program/lazy/seam_rules.rs, visible to all of `program`; Front2Program's side is an OLD/NEW for the coordinator
